title: TOFU add-time pin-substitution rejection (-EEXIST on key change) untested anywhere
description: lichen_peer_add (lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lichen_l2_peer.c:302-322) must reject a different pubkey for an already-pinned EUI-64 with -EEXIST (constant-time crypto_verify32). No test in the repo asserts this branch (l2_key_selection's trust_pin mirror uses plain memcmp; ping_l2 adds one fixed peer). Attack: a refactor returning 0 on pubkey mismatch enables silent key substitution under a pinned SIID - precisely the spec 02 4.2 step 4 attack. Add a fail-closed host test for the add-time half (verify-time half is covered by the decoy test).
